## Why it matters

Wien Geschichte Wiki is the City of Vienna's historical knowledge platform, built on the Felix Czeike lexicon and expanded with articles on people, places, buildings, organizations, and events.

The combination of encyclopedia entries, images, maps, and dedicated research tools makes it a strong reference point for urban history and topographical work on Vienna.
